papers.title: Tropical Attention: Neural Algorithmic Reasoning for Combinatorial Algorithms
papers.abstract: We introduce Tropical Attention, an attention mechanism grounded in tropical geometry that lifts the attention kernel into tropical projective space, where reasoning is piecewise-linear and 1-Lipschitz.

papers.title: Primal-Dual Neural Algorithmic Reasoning
papers.abstract: We introduce a general NAR framework grounded in the primal-dual paradigm, a classical method for designing efficient approximation algorithms.

papers.title: Discrete Neural Algorithmic Reasoning
papers.abstract: We propose to force neural reasoners to maintain the execution trajectory as a combination of finite predefined states.

papers.title: Open-Book Neural Algorithmic Reasoning
papers.abstract: We propose a novel open-book learning framework where the network can access and utilize all instances in the training dataset when reasoning for a given instance.

papers.title: Deep Equilibrium Algorithmic Reasoning
papers.abstract: We study neurally solving algorithms from a different perspective: since the algorithm's solution is often an equilibrium, it is possible to find the solution directly by solving an equilibrium equation.
